method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: World stocks fall as new US tariffs loom, AI rebound fizzles
Equities.reason: Broad market piece tying US tariff risk to a fading AI-led rally — frames a risk-off shift and a weakening market regime, making this a high-relevance negative for equities.

Equities.title: Nasdaq futures slide over 2% on fresh US tariff concerns; inflation data in focus
Equities.reason: US futures and tech-focused sell-off tied to tariff headlines and macro data risk — direct negative signal for risk assets and AI/tech leadership.

Equities.title: Equities: Rotation favors defensives over tech – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Research Team highlights that the recent equity rebound stalled, with the S&P 500 and Stoxx 600 posting modest declines. Tech, especially semiconductors, saw sharp losses, while sectors like Healthcare, consumer staples and real estate outperformed.
Equities.reason: Research note explicitly documents rotation away from tech into defensives — reinforces the prevailing risk-off/sector-rotation narrative for equities.

Equities.title: Defensive stocks lift FTSE 100 as US inflation data, tariffs loom
Equities.reason: Regional market move showing defensive leadership amid macro and tariff worries — consistent with broader risk-off / rotation theme, moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia fuels Washington fight over China's chip access
Equities.reason: Political/regulatory backlash around Nvidia leadership and US-China tech access increases governance and policy risk for AI/semiconductor leaders — a meaningful negative for tech beta.

Equities.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Nvidia Euphoria Fades, New Tariffs Loom
Equities.reason: Market-focused report linking fading Nvidia-led momentum and tariff chatter to sharp moves in the Nasdaq 100 — high relevance negative for US tech-led markets.

Equities.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price. Traders see even more pain
Equities.summary: Anthropic shares fell below the $83 IPO price as options activity surged, with large put buys, call buys and put sales pointing to a divided market.
Equities.reason: Weak performance and options activity around a major AI IPO signal cooling investor appetite for AI listings — a negative micro/sector datapoint supporting the broader narrative.

Equities.title: Buy the stock dip? Options market signals say wait
Equities.reason: Options-implied caution suggests investors are not confidently buying dips — market structure signal that amplifies downside risk for equities.

Equities.title: Global Rotation on AI Fears Lifts Indian Stocks to Top Spot
Equities.reason: Flow shift away from US/AI into Indian equities illustrates cross-market reallocation driven by AI fears — supports a narrative of uneven global performance and sector/region rotation.

Equities.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback
Equities.summary: The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic positive: strong AI-driven results and a large buyback are supportive for equipment/AI beneficiaries, but limited relevance versus the broader risk-off market narrative.

Rates.title: US core PCE inflation set to accelerate in October as Federal Reserve weighs further rate hikes
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) will publish the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data for October on Wednesday at 13:30 GMT.
Rates.reason: Core PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge; a projected acceleration raises the odds of further Fed tightening and higher-for-longer rates, pressuring bond prices (yields up). High market relevance given imminent data release.

Rates.title: Treasuries Rise Across Curve as AI Concerns Dent Risk Sentiment
Rates.reason: Risk-off driven by AI concerns has spurred safe-haven demand into Treasuries, causing a cross-curve rally (yields down). This is a clear short-term bond-positive flow.

Rates.title: Tech Selloff Rolls On as Haven Demand Lifts Bonds: Markets Wrap
Rates.reason: Reinforces the same risk-off/haven narrative: equity weakness is translating into bond demand and lower yields. Useful corroboration of near-term bond rally dynamics.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Rush to Hedge Risk of Fed Hikes Stalling Economy
Rates.reason: Market positioning described suggests traders are hedging macro downside risk from policy tightening, implying demand for duration/protection and greater bond-market caution (bias toward lower yields / rally in safe bonds).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes provide the clearest read on policy deliberations; in the current macro cycle markets are sensitive to any hawkish language that supports higher-for-longer rates. That tends to be bond-negative (yields up).

Rates.title: BOJ Likely to Lift Rate to 2% by Mid-2027, Ex-Board Member Says
Rates.reason: Comments suggesting material BOJ tightening imply higher JGB yields and potential upward pressure on global sovereign yields, a modestly bond-negative development for the broader rates complex.

FX.title: Euro slips as US PCE inflation puts Fed tightening bets to the test
FX.summary: EUR/USD declines by 0.21% on Wednesday, trading around 1.0940 at the time of writing.
FX.reason: US PCE inflation is the Fed's preferred gauge; stronger PCE lifts Fed tightening bets and the USD, pressuring EUR/USD. High macro relevance for dollar/major-pair dynamics.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Struggles to extend rally beyond 61.8% Fibo retracement at 104.65
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) bounces back against its major peers on Wednesday after a corrective move the previous day. As of writing, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades 0.2% higher to near 104.05.
FX.reason: DXY intraday bounce signals renewed USD strength vs majors; DXY moves are primary transmission for FX majors and constrain non‑USD currencies.

FX.title: Euro: Riding out Dollar storm – ING
FX.summary: Chris Turner at ING notes Eurozone business confidence remains robust despite higher energy prices and tighter policy, but the Euro is held back by Dollar strength and a lingering French risk premium. He argues EUR/USD has overshot rate differentials on the do
FX.reason: Institutional FX view explicitly attributes EUR underperformance to USD strength — reinforces the dominant dollar-centric narrative weighing on EUR/USD.

FX.title: Aussie Set for Worst Month Since 2013 on Risk-Averse Selling
FX.reason: Bloomberg headline points to broad risk-aversion and AUD underperformance versus USD — aligns with dollar/flight‑to‑safety flows pressuring commodity currencies.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Downside extends below hold 50% Fibo retracement
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) slides to a fresh 11-month low at 0.6559 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing AUD at multi-month lows. Relevant to AUD/USD but limited by technical focus (lower relevance cap).

FX.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Failure at 0.8370 confirms a Double Top formation
FX.summary: The US Dollar extends its decline against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Wednesday, as fresh doubts about the sustainability of the AI rally and news that the US administration is considering imposing additional tariffs on partners are dampening appetite for risk.
FX.reason: USD weakening vs CHF noted in a technical piece. Signals some safe‑haven CHF strength amid risk‑off/AI‑rally doubts, but technical focus limits relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee advances further as FIIs continue to raise stake in Indian stock market
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) resumes its upward trend against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a brief pause. The USD/INR pair slides to a fresh seven-month low at 92.28 as the consistent inflow of foreign capital into the Indian stock market keeps strengtheni
FX.reason: Persistent FII inflows are driving INR strength and USD/INR lower — a clear USD‑pair move with EM FX implications (capital flows underpinning currency move).

FX.title: Brazilian Real: Fiscal progress supports cautious rebound – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale EM strategists describe a sharp Brazilian Real rebound after the Lower House approved President Lula’s fiscal package, easing near-term concerns. They remain sceptical, stressing that further USD/BRL downside depends on domestic fiscal news, U
FX.reason: Domestic fiscal approval is supporting BRL and pushing USD/BRL lower. EM FX move with conditional upside — relevant but domestically driven, so moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold hovers near 14-month low as traders brace for US PCE inflation data
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates losses on Wednesday as traders turn cautious ahead of the US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index, due at 13:30 GMT. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $3,531, just above the 14-month low of $3,502 hit last
Commodities.reason: Gold weakening ahead of key US PCE and near multi-quarter lows; USD/inflation-driven pressure on precious metals = negative for gold prices. Timely market-moving data focus gives it high relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold slips on stronger dollar, US inflation data in focus
Commodities.reason: Reuters notes stronger USD and focus on US inflation—classic drivers pushing gold lower (higher real yields/strong dollar). Broad, authoritative coverage raises relevance and reinforces negative precious-metal narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold stays weak below $3,550 as traders await US PCE data for Fed cues amid firmer USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to a negative bias for the second straight day, trading below $3,550 through the first half of the European session on Wednesday and within striking distance of the year-to-date low amid a bearish fundamental backdrop.
Commodities.reason: Reinforces the USD/real-yield led softening in gold; consistent near-term negative bias but somewhat repetitive so slightly lower relevance than primary Reuters piece.

Commodities.title: $40: A level whose breakdown could expose Silver price below $37
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 1.5% to near $40.10 during the European trading session on Wednesday, the lowest level seen in over 14 months. The white metal faces selling pressure as the US Dollar (USD) regains ground after a corrective move the previous day.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-level piece pointing to a key support break for silver; USD strength and technical risk are negative. As a price-forecast/technical story, relevance capped at the framework limit (0.8).

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $40.26 per troy ounce, down 1.36% from the $40.81 it cost on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Intraday price move for silver tied to USD/market tone; short-term negative read with modest relevance as a routine price update.

Commodities.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
Commodities.reason: Institutional/digital settlement adoption in gold markets supports longer-term liquidity/market structure for the metal — modestly positive for gold demand/market efficiency, but not an immediate price shock.

Commodities.title: Oil Edges Lower as Expanding Supply Vies With Hormuz Attacks
Commodities.reason: Market sees rising supply weighing on prices even as geopolitical attacks near Hormuz add risk premium. Net near-term tilt lower for oil, but with elevated relevance because it captures the central supply/risk trade-off.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: Higher flows through chokepoints imply more physical supply reaching markets—negative for oil price risk premium. EIA data-driven item carries solid relevance for oil fundamentals.

Commodities.title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation
Commodities.summary: Ukraine’s foreign minister told Putin to end the war if he wants Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries, after Putin said retaliation was “inevitable.”
Commodities.reason: Escalating attacks on refineries raise disruption risk to Russian product supply and refining capacity—supportive for oil/fuel prices. Geopolitical refinery strikes are meaningful for near-term market risk-premium.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Hurricane threat to Gulf production and infrastructure increases the probability of supply disruptions/shut-ins — materially positive for nearby crude/natgas prices and market risk-premium.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: Inventories above the five-year average reduce near-term upward pressure on natural gas prices—negative fundamental impulse for natgas heading into winter demand season.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops as November spot ETF outflows increase to record $4.71 billion
Crypto.reason: Large, record spot-ETF outflows are a direct liquidity drain on Bitcoin demand and a clear short-term bearish market flow; high relevance as a market-moving capital-flow datapoint for BTC.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s drop to $55,000 left a record 11.6 million BTC underwater
Crypto.reason: Widening underwater supply indicates weak price support and potential for further liquidations; meaningful negative sentiment signal for BTC holders and market dynamics.

Crypto.title: BTCS sells more than half its ether to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt
Crypto.reason: Corporate-level liquidation of a large ETH holding to cover DeFi debt is direct selling pressure on Ether; relevant but idiosyncratic to one firm's balance-sheet actions.

Crypto.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
Crypto.reason: Removing a long-standing ICO ban would materially ease capital formation and signal pro-crypto policy in a major Asian market — a positive structural adoption/regulatory development.

Crypto.title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute
Crypto.reason: Regulatory support for bank-controlled stablecoins provides onshore rails and legal clarity — positive for institutional stablecoin adoption and broader crypto UX in South Korea.

Crypto.title: U.S. seeks $1.1 billion seized in Binance hack as North Korean funds keep moving
Crypto.reason: Ongoing movement of large hacked/seized balances and high-profile enforcement actions keep focus on illicit-use risks and counterparty security — negative for market trust and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level fixes signal ongoing stability issues for Solana; while an engineering attempt to improve performance, it highlights reliability risks that weigh on SOL sentiment.

Crypto.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
Crypto.reason: Expansion of crypto-native derivative products that let traders hedge non-crypto exposures demonstrates product innovation and deeper trading infrastructure — modestly positive for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
Crypto.reason: CFTC guidance on event-contract data provides regulatory clarity for a niche but growing corner of markets that often overlaps with crypto-native trading venues — net positive for market structure.

Crypto.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
Crypto.reason: Central-bank-level purchases of Bitcoin are a legitimizing signal for crypto adoption; limited by valuation opacity, so small positive impact on broader sentiment.
